title: Review the initial private EKS baseline live Terraform plan
expected_outcome: A saved read-only initial-baseline Terraform plan is reviewed for exact resource scope, private-network invariants, security controls, and material cost-bearing services; it does not authorize apply.
constraints: Use the approved Terraform role and pinned provider-mirror image. Do not apply, write/lock state, create ECR resources, mirror images, access Vault/EKS, or alter secrets.
Do not record raw Terraform plan/state values in Git evidence.

external_actions: read AWS provider and backend state through the approved Terraform role
create a temporary saved Terraform plan with state locking disabled

delegations.escalation_trigger: apply or any state/cloud mutation would be needed

validation: saved live plan with lock disabled
